summary: Approved. Verified on the rig: both hands stay 1.22-1.47 studs in front of the root through the whole cycle (1.22-1.28 at the top and bottom of each stroke) and travel 1.1 studs vertically (4.47 to 5.57); feet stay 0.79-0.88 in front. The reach now lands by about frame 10/25 and holds on the rung, the feet follow 3 frames later, and the chest turns the reaching shoulder toward the truss. Metrics all 0, overlap 1.0, no intersections, seam closed. Side view F000-F030 reads clearly as hand-over-hand on a truss in front. One low polish item remains.

findings.observation: Head.rx is still a flat -15 for the whole loop; only the small counter-turn on ry moves the head. A slight extra look-up as each hand lands would add life, but it is not noticeable at game distance.
